page.overview:
Who is Richard Levine?

Dr. Richard Levine is a wealthy paleontologist who appears only in . Like John Hammond, he is only interested in details, particularly the behavior of dinosaurs and does not much think of the consequences of his actions nor how the dinosaurs on Isla Sorna were created. In this way, he acts as the antithesis of Ian Malcolm, who shows interest in the cause and effect aspect of actions. The Lost World starts with a series of appearances of large and unknown lizards being found on the shores of Costa Rica. Levine and Martin Gutierrez travel to Costa Rica to investigate these appearances. Levine attempts to take pictures of a body of a large dinosaur carcass, identified as an Ornitholestes. Levine sends some of its flesh to Dr. Malcolm who inspects it with his friend Elizabeth Gelman.

During the events of he is in his early thirties. He is tall and dark. He often wears khaki clothing. He wears wire-frame spectacles and was known to be often cowardly towards the worst of situations.

He is precise in his movements and manner. He is generally agreed to be the best (and most irritating) paleontologist of his generation. Most people find him pompous and arrogant. He ignores his own plight, ignoring dangers to his own health, even after being bitten by a Procompsognathus, and was never grateful for being rescued. He thinks incredibly high of himself and very lowly of his peers, thinking of field work as mostly “poking around in animal crap”. Only after Ian Malcolm and Sarah Harding explain the effects of DX and him realizing he was bitten by a compy, does Levine realize he may suffer from adverse health effects.

Richard Levine was probably born in the early 1960s, since he is in his early thirties in 1993. Levine is part of the Estate of a famous toy series, the Becky Dolls. Though precise details remain unknown "Becky Dolls" could very well likely be a pseudonym for the "Pleasant Company" makers of requisite and quality dolls in the 1990s. The company is now called "American Girl" and remains successful throughout the decades, insinuating that therefore he is wealthy. The Becky Dolls could also be a pseudonym for "Barbie Dolls."
